primary.scope: Exact finite-bank descriptive target; no independent-edge sampling, confidence interval or universal robustness claim.

theorem_scope: Uniform shared derangement preserves equality for every board. Shared repeats always agree. The iid calibration family is violated; its upper bound need not cover marginal digit error. This says nothing about all correlated noise.

corruption_law_audit.justification: A bijection maps equal labels to equal labels and unequal labels to unequal labels. Sharing one draw between repeats makes both outputs identical. Uniform permutation rejection restricted to derangements is uniform on the accepted finite set.

limitations: Shared uniform derangements preserve relational information; arbitrary correlated noise need not.
IID calibration coverage theorem does not apply under shared repeated-query errors.
Finite-bank pooled structural counts, not independent edge trials or population accuracy.
No solver accuracy/certification experiment in this study.
BP AdamW outside this source-only mechanism study; not run.

runtime.accounting: Process user+system CPU for this orchestrator and all reaped children; active child CPU polled from /proc. OMP/OpenBLAS/MKL threads fixed to1.
